mathematical_lesson: Exact type growth is noncoercive when complement growth is component-separable: heterogeneous local disjoint covers multiplex by maximum local cost plus logarithmic component separation.

proposed_reusable_method_delta.name: component-coupling gate before amplification credit
preconditions: a proposed cover-amplification step adds new quotient types or semantic components
the complement relation and endpoint fibres are exactly available
steps: form the graph of complement support components
test for cross-component complement cells and endpoint-fibre coupling
attempt indexwise heterogeneous multiplexing plus binary component separation
credit amplification only if an explicit coupling falsifier defeats the upper construction
proposed_reusable_method_delta.transfer_condition: For t>=1 disjoint complement components with pairwise disjoint row and column projections and local disjoint generator-separating sizes k_r, rho(G)<=sigma(G)<=max_r k_r+ceil(log2 t).
falsifiers: a cross-component complement cell changes local endpoint fibres
a local family is not disjoint or fails generator separation
a source cover does not use the same full-cover polarity
non_guarantees: does not prove a lower bound
does not globally blacklist quotient growth
does not infer a uniform theorem from Q16
does not promote retrospective application evidence into framework authority
